United Kingdom · Pure Mathematics MSc; Mathematics Research PhD; see separate LSGNT dossier for funded four-year route
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: minimum UK 2:1 in mathematics/applied mathematics or overseas equivalent; UChicago mathematics
bachelor’s may qualify subject to grade equivalence. Ordinary PhD normally requires a first/upper-second
bachelor plus relevant master, or integrated master; exceptional research/accomplishments may justify an
exception. Do not treat bachelor-only direct PhD eligibility as automatic. The separate LSGNT route explicitly
welcomes outstanding four-year US bachelor students. International applicants considered; F-1 is not UK
immigration permission. [s1] [s3] [s14]
Before submission [Standing rule]
PhD: identify stream and contact a relevant supervisor with research fit and funding situation; proposed
supervisor agreement is compulsory for President’s competition, strongly encouraged for ordinary admission.
Prepare My Imperial account, documents, two academic referees. MSc: choose course/stream; seek fee waiver
before submitting if needed. [s1] [s4] [s10]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Strongly encouraged for ordinary PhD; essential prior agreement for President’s. Send focused research
alignment, preparation and funding-status note. LSGNT does not require selecting supervisor at application.
Faculty below are a verified relevant shortlist, not a promise of openings; confirm 2027 capacity. [s1] [s4] [s14]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
My Imperial handles documents and reference tracking; two choices maximum under taught guidance, second
choice reviewed after first unsuccessful/waitlisted. Do not trigger references before writers agree. Scholarship
funding selection matters. [s5] [s6] [s12]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
MSc and President’s dates/amounts explicitly 2027. Ordinary doctoral funding page mixes standing rules with
stale named schemes. Official site returned 403 on many direct opens; those sources are transparently
recorded as official indexed extracts, cross-checked against central admissions pages. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
MSc October 2027: 6 January, 10 March, or 28 April 2027, each 23:59 UK; corresponding decisions by 3 March,
5 May, 1 July. Applications open 30 September 2026; later availability not guaranteed. PhD: applications
accepted year-round, funding decisions mainly December-April; departmental recommendation
October-March, not a fixed final deadline. [s1] [s3]

Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
President’s 2027-28: 2 November 2026 (already passed), 11 January 2027, 1 March 2027, each 23:59 UK.
Decisions by 31 January, 15 April, 31 May respectively. Roth rolling, mostly November-March; EPSRC
allocations generally January-May. LSGNT has separate 31 December 2026 deadline. [s2] [s4] [s14]
Reference receipt [Unresolved]
MSc references need not arrive by round closing date but should arrive shortly afterwards; committee may
assess documents already received. PhD review starts only after both letters arrive. A separate public exact
President’s letter deadline was not established: arrange receipt before the chosen funding cutoff and confirm
departmental nomination timetable. [s1] [s5] [s6]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
English can be an offer condition, rather than pre-application requirement; satisfy before registration/visa
processing. Individual offer’s exact deadline controls. No GRE deadline established. [s1] [s8]
Supporting documents [Unresolved]
Upload supporting documents with application. MSc late references explicitly permitted briefly, but no general
supporting-document extension established. PhD funding documentation should be complete before relevant
round. Final qualification/English evidence follows offer conditions; exact dates not public. [s1] [s3] [s6]

amount/deadline and PhD acceptance date require offer-specific confirmation. [s3] [s4]

straightforward fit. [s1] [s5]

guidance encourages gender-neutral language. No third letter listed. Roth evaluates two references.

What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Automatic request when application is submitted, normally same day or shortly afterwards. Entering details

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
President’s explicit 2027-28: full tuition, £27,036 maintenance per year, £2,000/year consumables for first
three years. Roth/EPSRC promise stipend and tuition but annual mathematics-specific 2027 amount not
published in pages checked. MSc is not automatically funded; no guaranteed annual MSc support established.
[s2] [s4]
Years of support [Standing rule]
President’s 3.5 years; Roth normally 3.5 years; EPSRC up to 3.5 years. MSc one year full-time/two part-time is
course duration, not a funding guarantee. [s2] [s3] [s4]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
President’s all nationalities. Full departmental Roth awards open Home/Overseas. Administrative Roth tied to
supervisors may cover only Home tuition or require joint funding - verify full overseas fee gap. EPSRC overseas
awards limited (department reports normally one outstanding overseas candidate yearly) with department
paying overseas fee difference for selected awards. [s2] [s4]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Scholarships competitive and conditional on academic qualifications. President’s normally first-class
undergraduate/integrated master, or distinction standalone master; special-case nomination possible.
Supervisor must agree and can hold only one President’s scholar at a time. Ordinary PhD offer normally follows
secured funding; communicate self-funding explicitly. [s1] [s4]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Ordinary submitted My Imperial PhD automatically considered for departmental/Imperial scholarships, but
President’s requires selecting its funding option and proposal/supervisor agreement. Individual grant and
external sponsorship conditions vary. [s2] [s4]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Separate LSGNT funded four-year programme particularly relevant. External government/sponsor awards may
help. CSC page says not recruiting for 2026/27 pending review, which does not confirm 2027/28 availability.
Lee Family listing is old 2025/26; do not reuse January 2025 deadline. MSc scholarship search includes
Martingale and India schemes with restricted eligibility; not assumed eligible. [s2] [s11] [s14]

Application fee [2027 confirmed]
2027-28: MSc £90 per application, including permitted second choice; PhD and combined 1+3 CDT applications
free. [s9]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Home/Overseas applicants facing documented financial hardship may request waiver before
submitting/paying. Complete Word waiver form and email with evidence to appfees@imperial.ac.uk. Criteria
include recent need-based undergraduate aid/bursary, benefits, temporary hardship and other documented
circumstances; unlisted hardship may also be explained. No fixed processing deadline found, so allow time.
[s10] [s12]

Imperial College London
United Kingdom · Pure Mathematics MSc; Mathematics Research PhD; see separate LSGNT dossier for funded four-year route
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Ordinary PhD normally needs a master; LSGNT explicitly accommodates outstanding US bachelor graduates.
• President’s earliest 2027 funding round already closed 2 November 2026.
• Administrative Roth award may leave an overseas tuition gap; request written full-fee confirmation.
• LSGNT is a separate application with different course-list and statement requirements.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: minimum UK 2:1 in mathematics/applied mathematics or overseas equivalent; UChicago mathematics
bachelor’s may qualify subject to grade equivalence. Ordinary PhD normally requires a first/upper-second
bachelor plus relevant master, or integrated master; exceptional research/accomplishments may justify an
exception. Do not treat bachelor-only direct PhD eligibility as automatic. The separate LSGNT route explicitly
welcomes outstanding four-year US bachelor students. International applicants considered; F-1 is not UK
immigration permission. [s1] [s3] [s14]
Before submission [Standing rule]
PhD: identify stream and contact a relevant supervisor with research fit and funding situation; proposed
supervisor agreement is compulsory for President’s competition, strongly encouraged for ordinary admission.
Prepare My Imperial account, documents, two academic referees. MSc: choose course/stream; seek fee waiver
before submitting if needed. [s1] [s4] [s10]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Strongly encouraged for ordinary PhD; essential prior agreement for President’s. Send focused research
alignment, preparation and funding-status note. LSGNT does not require selecting supervisor at application.
Faculty below are a verified relevant shortlist, not a promise of openings; confirm 2027 capacity. [s1] [s4] [s14]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
My Imperial handles documents and reference tracking; two choices maximum under taught guidance, second
choice reviewed after first unsuccessful/waitlisted. Do not trigger references before writers agree. Scholarship
funding selection matters. [s5] [s6] [s12]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
MSc and President’s dates/amounts explicitly 2027. Ordinary doctoral funding page mixes standing rules with
stale named schemes. Official site returned 403 on many direct opens; those sources are transparently
recorded as official indexed extracts, cross-checked against central admissions pages. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
MSc October 2027: 6 January, 10 March, or 28 April 2027, each 23:59 UK; corresponding decisions by 3 March,
5 May, 1 July. Applications open 30 September 2026; later availability not guaranteed. PhD: applications
accepted year-round, funding decisions mainly December-April; departmental recommendation
October-March, not a fixed final deadline. [s1] [s3]

Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
President’s 2027-28: 2 November 2026 (already passed), 11 January 2027, 1 March 2027, each 23:59 UK.
Decisions by 31 January, 15 April, 31 May respectively. Roth rolling, mostly November-March; EPSRC
allocations generally January-May. LSGNT has separate 31 December 2026 deadline. [s2] [s4] [s14]
Reference receipt [Unresolved]
MSc references need not arrive by round closing date but should arrive shortly afterwards; committee may
assess documents already received. PhD review starts only after both letters arrive. A separate public exact
President’s letter deadline was not established: arrange receipt before the chosen funding cutoff and confirm
departmental nomination timetable. [s1] [s5] [s6]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
English can be an offer condition, rather than pre-application requirement; satisfy before registration/visa
processing. Individual offer’s exact deadline controls. No GRE deadline established. [s1] [s8]
Supporting documents [Unresolved]
Upload supporting documents with application. MSc late references explicitly permitted briefly, but no general
supporting-document extension established. PhD funding documentation should be complete before relevant
round. Final qualification/English evidence follows offer conditions; exact dates not public. [s1] [s3] [s6]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal public acceptance deadline verified; follow individual offer and any scholarship terms. MSc deposit
amount/deadline and PhD acceptance date require offer-specific confirmation. [s3] [s4]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc/PhD Standard level. If testing required: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall and 6.0 each; TOEFL before 21 January
2026 92 overall/20 each, new scale from that date 4.5 overall/4.5 each; within two years of start. Other
accepted tests on linked English page. Doctoral academic communication requirement remains after entry. [s1]
[s3] [s8]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Completed qualification equivalent to UK degree obtained in the USA exempts proof of English for this
non-Business programme. UChicago bachelor’s therefore meets the published country criterion once
completed; anticipated-degree handling/needed final evidence must be confirmed in offer. No nationality
requirement in this exemption. [s7]
GRE General [Standing rule]
MSc departmental FAQ explicitly says GRE/GMAT not required. Ordinary PhD checklist does not request GRE; a
categorical not-considered rule or permission to upload optional scores was not established. [s1] [s11]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
MSc GRE not required; no specific mathematics subject GRE requirement listed for ordinary PhD. Do not infer
that unsolicited scores will be evaluated. [s1] [s11]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
PhD: transcripts required in online application; MSc academic qualification evidence/transcripts. Public pages
checked did not establish every transcript certification/translation/file-size detail; use My Imperial and offer
instructions. Final degree evidence may be a condition. [s1] [s12]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate ordinary MSc/PhD course-list document established from checklists. LSGNT does require one; see
separate dossier. [s1] [s11] [s14]

Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate ordinary-course syllabus upload established. LSGNT requires brief descriptions of relevant courses
within its topic list. [s1] [s14]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
PhD: two academic referees with professional email addresses. MSc: two; at least one academic, second
academic or relevant professional. For a current mathematics undergraduate, two academic faculty are the
straightforward fit. [s1] [s5]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
President’s uses the same two academic referees; exclude proposed PhD supervisor. Additional reference
guidance encourages gender-neutral language. No third letter listed. Roth evaluates two references.
Scholarship-specific referee question wording not reproduced publicly in sources checked. [s2] [s4]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Automatic request when application is submitted, normally same day or shortly afterwards. Entering details
alone shows Not submitted and does not send request. [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes, automatic requests follow submission; submit sufficiently early for referees. [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
My Imperial References tile distinguishes not submitted, pending sent, sent, complete, and waived; Complete
confirms referee submission. [s5]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
A referee may correct a submitted letter through Admissions Enquiry form; an alternative referee can submit
through that form quoting Application ID. Cross-application/year reuse not established. [s5]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
PhD CV required upload; exact length and format not specified in public checklist. MSc separate CV
requirement not settled by programme page; verify portal rather than assuming optional upload. [s1] [s3]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required personal statement serves SOP. General guidance typically one A4 page (guidance, not verified hard
portal limit). Faithful paraphrase: motivations for Imperial and other information strengthening application.
President’s overrides with prescribed two-page structure. [s1] [s12]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No distinct additional background essay established; ordinary personal statement is described under SOP.
President’s first page combines motivations for institution/scholarship and other supporting context. [s4] [s12]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
PhD communicate research fit, proposed supervisor and stream (Pure/Applied/Statistics/Mathematical
Finance); no separately specified research-interest essay length found. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
Ordinary mathematics PhD proposal not essential. President’s: required proposal on page two of a two-page
personal-statement document; page one motivations/supporting information. Updated statement may be
requested after departmental shortlisting; additional proposal upload only if department requests. First-person
voice encouraged. [s1] [s4]

No thesis/writing-sample requirement established for ordinary route; permission to upload unsolicited papers is
unknown. LSGNT expressly excludes extra theses. [s1] [s14]
Publications list [Unresolved]

assessment/CV, but a papers-versus-links upload rule was not publicly established. [s1] [s2]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate ordinary-route essay/list verified; see course-list field and LSGNT. [s1] [s14]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
President’s: select scholarship option in funding section of additional questions; upload two-page document,
first-page personal statement, second-page research proposal. No separate scholarship form, but supervisor
agreement and department nomination required. Other schemes may have separate conditions; no additional
Roth essay listed. [s2] [s4]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
Interviews may assess technical mathematics and motivation. No extra short answers or formatting/size limits
established outside the published statement guidance; check live My Imperial before drafting final files. [s1]
[s12]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
President’s explicit 2027-28: full tuition, £27,036 maintenance per year, £2,000/year consumables for first
three years. Roth/EPSRC promise stipend and tuition but annual mathematics-specific 2027 amount not
published in pages checked. MSc is not automatically funded; no guaranteed annual MSc support established.
[s2] [s4]
Years of support [Standing rule]
President’s 3.5 years; Roth normally 3.5 years; EPSRC up to 3.5 years. MSc one year full-time/two part-time is
course duration, not a funding guarantee. [s2] [s3] [s4]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
President’s all nationalities. Full departmental Roth awards open Home/Overseas. Administrative Roth tied to
supervisors may cover only Home tuition or require joint funding - verify full overseas fee gap. EPSRC overseas
awards limited (department reports normally one outstanding overseas candidate yearly) with department
paying overseas fee difference for selected awards. [s2] [s4]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Scholarships competitive and conditional on academic qualifications. President’s normally first-class
undergraduate/integrated master, or distinction standalone master; special-case nomination possible.
Supervisor must agree and can hold only one President’s scholar at a time. Ordinary PhD offer normally follows
secured funding; communicate self-funding explicitly. [s1] [s4]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Ordinary submitted My Imperial PhD automatically considered for departmental/Imperial scholarships, but
President’s requires selecting its funding option and proposal/supervisor agreement. Individual grant and
external sponsorship conditions vary. [s2] [s4]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Separate LSGNT funded four-year programme particularly relevant. External government/sponsor awards may
help. CSC page says not recruiting for 2026/27 pending review, which does not confirm 2027/28 availability.
Lee Family listing is old 2025/26; do not reuse January 2025 deadline. MSc scholarship search includes
Martingale and India schemes with restricted eligibility; not assumed eligible. [s2] [s11] [s14]

2027-28: MSc £90 per application, including permitted second choice; PhD and combined 1+3 CDT applications
free. [s9]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Home/Overseas applicants facing documented financial hardship may request waiver before
submitting/paying. Complete Word waiver form and email with evidence to appfees@imperial.ac.uk. Criteria
include recent need-based undergraduate aid/bursary, benefits, temporary hardship and other documented
circumstances; unlisted hardship may also be explained. No fixed processing deadline found, so allow time.

Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Departmental MSc FAQ says applications until places fill/no formal closing, while explicit 2027 prospectus gives
staged closing dates: follow current prospectus. Broad automatic-scholarship language does not remove
President’s selection/proposal/supervisor requirements. Old scheme deadlines and fellowship labels in research
pages are not current admission guarantees. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s11]

Confirm bachelor-only ordinary PhD exceptional eligibility or choose LSGNT/MSc; exact institutional grade
equivalence; ordinary funding stipend and overseas fee coverage; President’s reference/nomination timing;

Imperial College London
United Kingdom · Pure Mathematics MSc; Mathematics Research PhD; see separate LSGNT dossier for funded four-year route
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Ordinary PhD normally needs a master; LSGNT explicitly accommodates outstanding US bachelor graduates.
• President’s earliest 2027 funding round already closed 2 November 2026.
• Administrative Roth award may leave an overseas tuition gap; request written full-fee confirmation.
• LSGNT is a separate application with different course-list and statement requirements.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: minimum UK 2:1 in mathematics/applied mathematics or overseas equivalent; UChicago mathematics
bachelor’s may qualify subject to grade equivalence. Ordinary PhD normally requires a first/upper-second
bachelor plus relevant master, or integrated master; exceptional research/accomplishments may justify an
exception. Do not treat bachelor-only direct PhD eligibility as automatic. The separate LSGNT route explicitly
welcomes outstanding four-year US bachelor students. International applicants considered; F-1 is not UK
immigration permission. [s1] [s3] [s14]
Before submission [Standing rule]
PhD: identify stream and contact a relevant supervisor with research fit and funding situation; proposed
supervisor agreement is compulsory for President’s competition, strongly encouraged for ordinary admission.
Prepare My Imperial account, documents, two academic referees. MSc: choose course/stream; seek fee waiver
before submitting if needed. [s1] [s4] [s10]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Strongly encouraged for ordinary PhD; essential prior agreement for President’s. Send focused research
alignment, preparation and funding-status note. LSGNT does not require selecting supervisor at application.
Faculty below are a verified relevant shortlist, not a promise of openings; confirm 2027 capacity. [s1] [s4] [s14]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
My Imperial handles documents and reference tracking; two choices maximum under taught guidance, second
choice reviewed after first unsuccessful/waitlisted. Do not trigger references before writers agree. Scholarship
funding selection matters. [s5] [s6] [s12]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
MSc and President’s dates/amounts explicitly 2027. Ordinary doctoral funding page mixes standing rules with
stale named schemes. Official site returned 403 on many direct opens; those sources are transparently
recorded as official indexed extracts, cross-checked against central admissions pages. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
MSc October 2027: 6 January, 10 March, or 28 April 2027, each 23:59 UK; corresponding decisions by 3 March,
5 May, 1 July. Applications open 30 September 2026; later availability not guaranteed. PhD: applications
accepted year-round, funding decisions mainly December-April; departmental recommendation
October-March, not a fixed final deadline. [s1] [s3]

Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
President’s 2027-28: 2 November 2026 (already passed), 11 January 2027, 1 March 2027, each 23:59 UK.
Decisions by 31 January, 15 April, 31 May respectively. Roth rolling, mostly November-March; EPSRC
allocations generally January-May. LSGNT has separate 31 December 2026 deadline. [s2] [s4] [s14]
Reference receipt [Unresolved]
MSc references need not arrive by round closing date but should arrive shortly afterwards; committee may
assess documents already received. PhD review starts only after both letters arrive. A separate public exact
President’s letter deadline was not established: arrange receipt before the chosen funding cutoff and confirm
departmental nomination timetable. [s1] [s5] [s6]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
English can be an offer condition, rather than pre-application requirement; satisfy before registration/visa
processing. Individual offer’s exact deadline controls. No GRE deadline established. [s1] [s8]
Supporting documents [Unresolved]
Upload supporting documents with application. MSc late references explicitly permitted briefly, but no general
supporting-document extension established. PhD funding documentation should be complete before relevant
round. Final qualification/English evidence follows offer conditions; exact dates not public. [s1] [s3] [s6]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal public acceptance deadline verified; follow individual offer and any scholarship terms. MSc deposit
amount/deadline and PhD acceptance date require offer-specific confirmation. [s3] [s4]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc/PhD Standard level. If testing required: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall and 6.0 each; TOEFL before 21 January
2026 92 overall/20 each, new scale from that date 4.5 overall/4.5 each; within two years of start. Other
accepted tests on linked English page. Doctoral academic communication requirement remains after entry. [s1]
[s3] [s8]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Completed qualification equivalent to UK degree obtained in the USA exempts proof of English for this
non-Business programme. UChicago bachelor’s therefore meets the published country criterion once
completed; anticipated-degree handling/needed final evidence must be confirmed in offer. No nationality
requirement in this exemption. [s7]
GRE General [Standing rule]
MSc departmental FAQ explicitly says GRE/GMAT not required. Ordinary PhD checklist does not request GRE; a
categorical not-considered rule or permission to upload optional scores was not established. [s1] [s11]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
MSc GRE not required; no specific mathematics subject GRE requirement listed for ordinary PhD. Do not infer
that unsolicited scores will be evaluated. [s1] [s11]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
PhD: transcripts required in online application; MSc academic qualification evidence/transcripts. Public pages
checked did not establish every transcript certification/translation/file-size detail; use My Imperial and offer
instructions. Final degree evidence may be a condition. [s1] [s12]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate ordinary MSc/PhD course-list document established from checklists. LSGNT does require one; see
separate dossier. [s1] [s11] [s14]

Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate ordinary-course syllabus upload established. LSGNT requires brief descriptions of relevant courses
within its topic list. [s1] [s14]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
PhD: two academic referees with professional email addresses. MSc: two; at least one academic, second
academic or relevant professional. For a current mathematics undergraduate, two academic faculty are the
straightforward fit. [s1] [s5]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
President’s uses the same two academic referees; exclude proposed PhD supervisor. Additional reference
guidance encourages gender-neutral language. No third letter listed. Roth evaluates two references.
Scholarship-specific referee question wording not reproduced publicly in sources checked. [s2] [s4]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Automatic request when application is submitted, normally same day or shortly afterwards. Entering details
alone shows Not submitted and does not send request. [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes, automatic requests follow submission; submit sufficiently early for referees. [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
My Imperial References tile distinguishes not submitted, pending sent, sent, complete, and waived; Complete
confirms referee submission. [s5]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
A referee may correct a submitted letter through Admissions Enquiry form; an alternative referee can submit
through that form quoting Application ID. Cross-application/year reuse not established. [s5]

PhD CV required upload; exact length and format not specified in public checklist. MSc separate CV
requirement not settled by programme page; verify portal rather than assuming optional upload. [s1] [s3]

Required personal statement serves SOP. General guidance typically one A4 page (guidance, not verified hard
portal limit). Faithful paraphrase: motivations for Imperial and other information strengthening application.
President’s overrides with prescribed two-page structure. [s1] [s12]

President’s first page combines motivations for institution/scholarship and other supporting context. [s4] [s12]

Finance); no separately specified research-interest essay length found. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
Ordinary mathematics PhD proposal not essential. President’s: required proposal on page two of a two-page
personal-statement document; page one motivations/supporting information. Updated statement may be
requested after departmental shortlisting; additional proposal upload only if department requests. First-person
voice encouraged. [s1] [s4]

Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
No thesis/writing-sample requirement established for ordinary route; permission to upload unsolicited papers is
unknown. LSGNT expressly excludes extra theses. [s1] [s14]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate mandatory publications-list document established. Research outputs can inform PhD
assessment/CV, but a papers-versus-links upload rule was not publicly established. [s1] [s2]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate ordinary-route essay/list verified; see course-list field and LSGNT. [s1] [s14]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
President’s: select scholarship option in funding section of additional questions; upload two-page document,
first-page personal statement, second-page research proposal. No separate scholarship form, but supervisor
agreement and department nomination required. Other schemes may have separate conditions; no additional
Roth essay listed. [s2] [s4]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
Interviews may assess technical mathematics and motivation. No extra short answers or formatting/size limits
established outside the published statement guidance; check live My Imperial before drafting final files. [s1]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
President’s explicit 2027-28: full tuition, £27,036 maintenance per year, £2,000/year consumables for first
three years. Roth/EPSRC promise stipend and tuition but annual mathematics-specific 2027 amount not
published in pages checked. MSc is not automatically funded; no guaranteed annual MSc support established.
[s2] [s4]
Years of support [Standing rule]
President’s 3.5 years; Roth normally 3.5 years; EPSRC up to 3.5 years. MSc one year full-time/two part-time is
course duration, not a funding guarantee. [s2] [s3] [s4]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
President’s all nationalities. Full departmental Roth awards open Home/Overseas. Administrative Roth tied to
supervisors may cover only Home tuition or require joint funding - verify full overseas fee gap. EPSRC overseas
awards limited (department reports normally one outstanding overseas candidate yearly) with department
paying overseas fee difference for selected awards. [s2] [s4]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Scholarships competitive and conditional on academic qualifications. President’s normally first-class
undergraduate/integrated master, or distinction standalone master; special-case nomination possible.
Supervisor must agree and can hold only one President’s scholar at a time. Ordinary PhD offer normally follows
secured funding; communicate self-funding explicitly. [s1] [s4]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Ordinary submitted My Imperial PhD automatically considered for departmental/Imperial scholarships, but
President’s requires selecting its funding option and proposal/supervisor agreement. Individual grant and
external sponsorship conditions vary. [s2] [s4]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Separate LSGNT funded four-year programme particularly relevant. External government/sponsor awards may
help. CSC page says not recruiting for 2026/27 pending review, which does not confirm 2027/28 availability.
Lee Family listing is old 2025/26; do not reuse January 2025 deadline. MSc scholarship search includes

2027-28: MSc £90 per application, including permitted second choice; PhD and combined 1+3 CDT applications
free. [s9]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Home/Overseas applicants facing documented financial hardship may request waiver before
submitting/paying. Complete Word waiver form and email with evidence to appfees@imperial.ac.uk. Criteria
include recent need-based undergraduate aid/bursary, benefits, temporary hardship and other documented
circumstances; unlisted hardship may also be explained. No fixed processing deadline found, so allow time.
